sentences.text: This is 1st bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

Applicant has been arrested on 19.6.2022 by police Station, Dehat, Distt. Ashoknagar, in connection with crime No.457/2022 for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366A, 376(2)(n) of IPC,
Sections 3/4 of the POCSO Act 09:50:40 AM and Sections 3(1)(w)(1), 3(2)(v) of the SC/ST Act.

In brief prosecution case is that on 16.6.2022 father of the prosecutrix lodged a report at police Dinesh Kushwaha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/112884480/
1 Station Dehat, Ashoknagar, that yesterday after taking dinner at 8 pm they slept.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: At 1 am when he awoke, he found that his daughter, the prosecutrix, aged about 12 years is missing.
Thereafter he got up other family members and searched her, but she could not be traced.
Somebody took away by persuading her.
On his report, offence under Section 363 was registered along with Gum Insan report.
Prosecutrix was recovered on 19.6.2022.
Her statement was recorded on the same day in which she has stated that she is aged about 12 years.
Her father Sukhdev is no more.
Her mother solemnized marriage with Jasman Kushwah.

On 15.6.2022 in the night at 10-11 pm present applicant came to her house and on the pretext of marriage took away to Aavri by foot, kept her in a field and 3-4 times committed sexual intercourse with her.
Thereafter they went to Guna by bus and stayed there 3-4 days.
After his statement, offences under Sections 366A, 376 (2)(n) of IPC, Sections 3/4 of the POCSO Act and Sections 3(1)(w)(1), 3(2)(v) of the SC/ST Act were enhanced.
Prosecutrix was sent for medical examination.
No injury was found on her person.
Applicant was arrested on 19.6.2022.
After investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and falsely implicated in the case.
He is in custody since 19.6.2022.
As per the ossification report, prosecutrix was found to be 15 years of age.
Investigation has been complete and charge-sheet has been filed.
He undertakes to cooperate in trial.
Conclusion of trial will take time.
On such premises, learned counsel for the applicant prayed for bail.
Learned counsel for the State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
Both the Advocates are heard.
Case diary perused.

Looking to the facts & circumstances of the case, without commenting upon merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the application it is ordered that if the applicant furnishes cash surety of Rs.25,000/- alongwith bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees twenty five thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, he should be released on bail.
He will present during trial before the trial Court on each and every date.
In case of default, cash surety of Rs. 25,000/- shall stand forfeited automatically.
Application stands allowed and disposed of.
Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DEEPAK KUMAR AGARWAL) JUDGE ms/-
